### Describe the Bug
A clear and concise description of what happened when running a prompt with an AI agent.

### Prompt Used
- File: `prompts/stage-X/...`
- AI Model / Tool: (e.g. Cursor, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Windsurf, Antigravity)

### Expected Behavior
What the prompt should have instructed the agent to do.

### Actual Output
What the agent actually did or where it hallucinated.
